tool: census performed by hand over both trees
question: which route on this machine can execute a CLIP Vision ConvRot INT8 pack

comfyui_stock.why: manual_cast derives from disable_weight_init and never calls _load_quantized_module, so comfy_quant is ignored and the int8 codes stay in a float Parameter

hswq_loader.how: after the tower is built, each declared layer is swapped for comfy.ops.mixed_precision_ops' Linear and its {weight, weight_scale, bias, comfy_quant} is loaded into it

a1111_controlnet.why: the extension has no clip_vision model input at all; it consumes pre-computed embeddings

conclusion: One route on this machine executes the pack as ConvRot INT8: HSWQLoadClipVision. The stock route loads the same file without interpreting comfy_quant.
